findings.what: Exercise 9.11's (i)-(vii) item labels are gone. The book numbers the seven incomplete reactions (i) C6H5NH2 + CHCl3 + alc.KOH, (ii) C6H5N2Cl + H3PO2 + H2O, (iii) C6H5NH2 + H2SO4 (conc.), (iv) C6H5N2Cl + C2H5OH, (v) C6H5NH2 + Br2(aq), (vi) C6H5NH2 + (CH3CO)2O, (vii) C6H5N2Cl with (i)HBF4 / (ii)NaNO2/Cu,delta. The render prints all seven equations unlabelled.
The folio prints the page number twice: the running text reads 'Chemistry 280' and is followed by a yellow '280' badge. The book sets 'Chemistry' then the number badge once.

The exercise stem numbers 9.10, 9.11, 9.12, 9.13 are run inline at the head of an indented paragraph instead of hanging in bold in the left margin as the book sets them (9.14 alone keeps a margin number), and the red vertical bar the book runs down the left edge of the exercise block is not drawn.
Word spaces after the roman labels of exercise 9.14 are dropped: '(i)Why are amines less acidic...', '(ii)Why do primary amines...', '(iii)Why are aliphatic amines...'.
The bottom half of the page is empty below the single answer line. The two missing answer lines account for part of it; I cannot tell whether the chapter's end matter carried anything else there.

note: Compared block by block against book page 280. Present and correct: exercises 9.10 and 9.12 to 9.14 in full with their text, all seven 9.11 equations including the (i)HBF4 / (ii)NaNO2/Cu,delta reagents stacked over the arrow, the bold 'Answers to Some Intext Questions' heading, and subscripts throughout the formulae. 9.14's three sub-items do keep their (i)-(iii) labels; it is 9.11 and the answers that lost theirs.
